content:
A water line break has closed the area between International Boulevard and Orange Blossom and Shiloh Drive in Laredo until further notice, according to the Laredo Police Department.

City utility crews are on scene working on the break, and police officers are directing traffic in the area.

Drivers should use alternate routes and expect delays, police said.

Update — November 7, 2026

District 7 Council Member Dr. Tyler King criticized the city’s lack of updates to residents during the outage, while thanking the crews who worked on the repair, according to KGNS. King said many residents waited nearly 16 hours for water to return after a bolt failed on the main near International Boulevard and Shiloh Drive on Friday, November 6. He said changes are needed so the city can respond faster, and he proposed creating a separate public utility that would operate autonomously, without red tape, with a board still reporting to the City Council. King acknowledged creating such a utility would take time and said he is committed to making it happen. KGNS also reported that city crews were handling planned valve replacements in South Laredo when the break occurred. The report did not give an exact restoration time or a number of affected households.

Sources: Laredo Police Department; KGNS, November 7, 2026.
